Scope and method: Planning and conducting information security tests; analysing findings and mitigation
Reported contribution: Provides a lifecycle for selecting test techniques and translating findings into mitigation
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Guidance only; supplies no results for Metasploitable 2 or Lucid Jungles

Scope and method: Analysis of automated black-box web application vulnerability testing
Reported contribution: Frames automated web testing as a bounded technique with coverage limitations
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Web-focused and not a network-service or city-risk assessment

Scope and method: Evaluation of black-box web vulnerability scanners
Reported contribution: Provides benchmark evidence on scanner behaviour against web applications
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Results depend on applications, scanner versions, and test conditions

Scope and method: Comparative assessment of four open-source web vulnerability scanners and a scanner-output case study
Reported contribution: Reports disagreement between scanner outputs that is not necessarily explained by performance differences
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Limited to the tools and web applications in the study

Scope and method: Review of 90 papers and 30 web vulnerability scanners
Reported contribution: Highlights uneven quantitative evaluation and heterogeneous scanner coverage
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Web-centric evidence; does not establish coverage for mixed network services

Scope and method: Combines Arachni and OWASP ZAP into one reporting approach
Reported contribution: Reports improved recall and F-measure for the evaluated setting
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Study-specific result; not a performance claim about this lab

Scope and method: Metasploitable 2 training image and example service inventory
Reported contribution: Defines the VM as intentionally vulnerable and warns against hostile-network exposure
Limit for the Bazaar pilot: Vendor documentation and example inventory are not observations of the group's VM
